AI_OCR_Receiver.description: Apply to an XUpload field that should receive OCR-extracted text. The OCR result is placed into the element matching data-cb-Field.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Input.description: Apply to the text input field of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Input.descriptionDe: Auf das Texteingabefeld eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Input.descriptionIt: Applicare al campo di immissione testo di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Send.description: Apply to the send button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Send.descriptionDe: Auf die Senden-Schaltfläche eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Send.descriptionIt: Applicare al pulsante di invio di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Stop.description: Apply to the stop button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Stop.descriptionDe: Auf die Stopp-Schaltfläche eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Stop.descriptionIt: Applicare al pulsante di arresto di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Upload.description: Apply to the file upload button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Upload.descriptionDe: Auf die Datei-Upload-Schaltfläche eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Upload.descriptionIt: Applicare al pulsante di caricamento file di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Thinking.description: Apply to the thinking indicator element of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Thinking.descriptionDe: Auf das Denk-Indikator-Element eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Thinking.descriptionIt: Applicare all'elemento indicatore di elaborazione di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Internet.description: Apply to the internet search toggle of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Internet.descriptionDe: Auf den Internet-Suche-Schalter eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Internet.descriptionIt: Applicare all'interruttore di ricerca su Internet di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Location.description: Apply to the location sharing button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Location.descriptionDe: Auf die Standortfreigabe-Schaltfläche eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_Location.descriptionIt: Applicare al pulsante di condivisione posizione di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailForward.description: Apply to the mail forward button of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailForward.descriptionDe: Auf die Mail-Weiterleiten-Schaltfläche eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailForward.descriptionIt: Applicare al pulsante di inoltro e-mail di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailAddress.description: Apply to the mail address input of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailAddress.descriptionDe: Auf das E-Mail-Adress-Eingabefeld eines AI-LLAMA-Chat-Widgets anwenden.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_MailAddress.descriptionIt: Applicare al campo dell'indirizzo e-mail di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_CHAT_AlertOnFinish.description: Apply to the alert-on-finish toggle of an AI LLAMA chat widget.
AI_LLAMA_CHAT_AlertOnFinish.descriptionIt: Applicare all'interruttore di avviso al termine di un widget chat AI LLAMA.

AI_LLAMA_QA_Exclude.description: Apply to a container (XContainer) element whose contents should be excluded from AI question search.
AI_LLAMA_QA_Exclude.descriptionDe: Auf ein Container-Element (XContainer) anwenden, dessen Inhalte von der KI-Fragesuche ausgeschlossen werden sollen.
AI_LLAMA_QA_Exclude.descriptionIt: Applicare a un elemento contenitore (XContainer) i cui contenuti devono essere esclusi dalla ricerca delle domande dell'IA.

AI_LLAMA_STANDARD_QA_Question.description: Apply to an XTextField that receives AI responses to questions specified in data-cb-Question.

AI_LLAMA_STANDARD_TXTQA_Question.description: Apply to an XTextField that receives AI responses to questions based on source fields.
AI_LLAMA_STANDARD_TXTQA_Question.descriptionDe: Auf ein XTextField anwenden, das die KI-Antworten auf Fragen zu den Quellfeldern erhält.
AI_LLAMA_STANDARD_TXTQA_Question.descriptionIt: Applicare a un XTextField che riceve le risposte dell'IA alle domande basate sui campi di origine.

AI_LLAMA_TXTQA_Source.description: Apply to an XTextField whose value should be supplied as source context to the AI for question answering.
AI_LLAMA_TXTQA_Source.descriptionDe: Auf ein XTextField anwenden, dessen Wert der KI als Quellkontext für die Fragebeantwortung übergeben werden soll.
AI_LLAMA_TXTQA_Source.descriptionIt: Applicare a un XTextField il cui valore deve essere fornito all'IA come contesto di origine per la risposta alle domande.

CodBi_AI_OCR_Receiver.description: Tags the field that receives the response from a AI.OCR functionality.
CodBi_AI_OCR_Receiver.descriptionDe: Markiert das Feld welches die Antwort von einem AI.OCR erhält.
CodBi_AI_OCR_Receiver.descriptionIt: Campo destinato alla risposta dell'AI OCR.
